basis: Current wording Section C.10 states the utilization sequence as Base Sum Insured, followed by Super Credit if applicable, followed by Super Reload, followed by Cancer Booster if applicable.
Current wording Section C.13.10 repeats the same sequence for Cancer Booster.

SUPER_RELOAD.interaction_note: Current wording states Super Reload follows Base Sum Insured and Super Credit in the utilization sequence.

super_credit_precedes_super_reload.basis: Direct consequence of the asserted utilization sequence.

super_reload_precedes_cancer_booster.basis: Direct consequence of the asserted utilization sequence.

explicit_boundaries: The ordering rule does not determine claim admissibility.
The ordering rule does not calculate payable claim amount.
The ordering rule does not establish that Super Credit or Cancer Booster is applicable in every policy.
The ordering rule does not resolve copayment, deductible, waiting-period, or other claim-cost ordering.
Unknown node applicability must remain unresolved and must not be treated as absent.
gate_conclusion: The current source resolves a four-stage capacity utilization order strongly enough to support bounded generic next-capacity selection without a general claims-adjudication engine.
